address: The Old Coach House, Peasholme Green, York, YO1 7PW, United Kingdom
bio: On the edge of York’s buzzing centre, you’ll find this brick-built former coaching house. Inside, the compact dining room is bright and airy thanks to a large skylight, while the white-and-blue décor lends a Mediterranean feel. In the summer, head for the lovely enclosed terrace overlooking the well-kept gardens. The cooking is guided by the seasons and comes with inventive touches and combinations. Cheese-lovers should save room for the excellent British selection presented on a handmade oak trolley....
